rationale: The agent verified identity appropriately using full name plus zip, mapping to a single user ID before accessing account details. For order changes, the agent inspected orders and products via read-only tools, confirmed eligibility (both orders pending), and performed modifications only after explicit user authorization: the watch change was explicitly requested (“Can we proceed with that change?”) and executed to the correct leather/black variant with the correct refund; the laptop change was explicitly confirmed to item 9844888101 in order #W3730488 and executed with the correct refund. The agent did not perform writes without user confirmation, acted only on the authenticated user’s orders, and all post-action details matched tool outputs. Minor improvement opportunity: explicitly restate the exact watch change and order ID before committing, and offer to use the NYC address from a prior order with user confirmation.
